# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 02 Sep 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Land Market

- **Record OCR land bid of S$1,537 psf ppr for Upper Changi Road GLS site** - A consortium of UOL Group, CapitaLand Development, and SingLand submitted the top bid of S$1.43 billion (S$1,537 psf ppr) for a Bedok GLS site, setting a new benchmark for suburban residential land. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-upper-changi-road-gls-site-draws-record-ocr-land-bid-of-s1537-psf-ppr/)

- **Two new 99-year leasehold condos launching in September 2026** - Amberwood at Holland (District 10) and Lucerne Grand (beside Lakeside MRT) are both set to open for sale this month. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/amberwood-at-holland-lucerne-grand-new-launch-september-2026/)

- **Freehold Novena condo The Serra Residences previewed ahead of launch** - Early details have emerged on the 133-unit freehold development in Novena, covering its unit mix, indicative pricing, and a 50m pool and tennis court among its facilities. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/upcoming-133-unit-freehold-novena-condo-50m-pool-and-tennis-court-what-we-know-so-far/)

- **Marina Square to undergo its biggest transformation in 40 years** - SingLand's redevelopment plan includes three new towers, a 49-storey luxury residential component, offices, and a revamped mall, with completion targeted by 2031. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/marina-squares-biggest-transformation-40-years-49-storey-luxury-condo-major-mall-overhaul/)

## HDB Resale Milestones

- **Pasir Ris records its first million-dollar 5-room flat at S$1.15M** - A 5-room DBSS flat at Block 530D Pasir Ris Drive 1 transacted at S$1.15 million, the first time a 5-room flat in the estate has crossed the million-dollar mark. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/pasir-ris-first-million-dollar-hdb-sale/)

- **Tampines DBSS flat sets new record at $1.12M** - A five-room unit at 519B Tampines Central 8 sold for $1,120,000 ($963 psf) in August 2026, establishing a new price record for that flat type at the Centrale 8 development. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/tampines-dbss-flat-sold-for-record-1-12m-why-buyers-paying-premium/)

## En Bloc & Resale Market

- **Gilstead Court launches fourth en bloc attempt at $198M reserve price** - The freehold Novena condo is making its fourth collective sale bid since 2005, though its low 1.4 plot ratio has been noted as a potential challenge for attracting developer interest. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/freehold-novena-condo-for-en-bloc-sale-198m-after-3-failed-attempts/)

- **Condo resale volumes rebounded in July 2026 as prices edged lower** - Transaction numbers rose month-on-month but overall resale prices dipped slightly, even as they remained above year-ago levels, with volume still slightly below the typical monthly norm. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-rebounds-in-july-2026-as-prices-edge-lower/)
